versions.changelog:
Initial release of guaikei抖音内容决策数据 skill.

- Provides four core capabilities: keyword search (videos/images/users with filtering), batch creator content fetch, video comment analysis, and real-time trending list queries.
- Tailored for Douyin (TikTok China) public data research, competition analysis, topic exploration, and trend monitoring via structured JSON output.
- Command-line interface with strict parameter and output conventions; robust error handling and token management.
- Not suitable for video publishing, editing, download, follower-boost/operation consulting; only for Douyin public data, not other platforms.
- Access controlled by environment variable token with comprehensive compliance guidelines.
